an9.34:1.1: 34 ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sāriputto rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe
an9.34:1.2: tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi
an9.34:1.5: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyi āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca
an9.34:1.6: kiṃ panettha āvuso sāriputta sukhaṃ yadettha natthi vedayitanti.
an9.34:1.7: etadeva khvettha āvuso sukhaṃ yadettha natthi vedayitaṃ
an9.34:1.10: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
an9.34:1.14: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
an9.34:1.16: yaṃ kho āvuso ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ idaṃ vuccatāvuso kāmasukhaṃ.
an9.34:2.1: idhāvuso bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.34:2.2: tassa ce āvuso bhikkhuno iminā vihārena viharato kāmasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti svāssa hoti ābādho
an9.34:2.3: seyyathāpi āvuso sukhino dukkhaṃ uppajjeyya yāva deva ābādhāya
an9.34:2.4: evamevassa te kāmasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti svāssa hoti ābādho
an9.34:2.5: yo kho panāvuso ābādho dukkhametaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā
an9.34:2.6: imināpi kho etaṃ āvuso pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathāsukhaṃ nibbānaṃ.
